verdict.rationale: Generating API reference pages from an OpenAPI spec is a fair axis for a documentation framework, so it applies here. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Docusaurus or an official plugin turning an OpenAPI spec into reference pages or keeping them in sync. The pluggable architecture and MDX/React support are generic extension points, not evidence of this capability, and the OpenAPI probe only checked whether docusaurus.io publishes its own spec, which is off-topic.
